verdict.rationale: LibreChat has official maintained guides for Docker Compose (recommended method) and Kubernetes via Helm chart, plus an npm-based install path and a remote/local deployment comparison page, but there is no evidence of a dedicated small-VPS guide or a Raspberry Pi-specific guide. Missing for 10: a documented VPS-specific deployment guide, a Raspberry Pi/ARM installation guide, and independent confirmation these guides are actively maintained.
